messages.subject: Spatial model for recurrents events
parts:
Hello everyone,
I'm blocked on a spatial model with recurrents events. In fact, geolocalization concerns households that may contain several children on which the events are observed.It's a model that I used in 2019 on other databases but it doesn't work since October 2020 and I don't know why.  Please, could someone help me?

The model is :

formula14 = inla.surv(times14, Status, subject) ~ 0 + a0 + Trait + ClassAge+Sexe + f(Order, model="ar1")

ModelRec14 = inla(formula14, family="weibullsurv", data=inla.stack.data(Stack14), control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(Stack14)), control.compute = list(dic=TRUE,mlik=TRUE,graph=TRUE, waic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE),verbose=TRUE,control.inla = list (strategy = "laplace",npoints=35,int.strategy="eb",h=1e-15))


Bests regards
